findings.problem: The temporal clause 『在它得到答复前』 calques 'until it is answered': 它 stands in for the request as the clause subject, where corpus notices about the same request name the request or open on the verb (ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_gone 『该请求已不再等待回复』; ui.chat.asks.status.withdrawn 『智能体不再需要回答』). It reads slightly translated rather than native notice copy.
findings.suggestion: 『收到答复前，此输入框将暂停使用，草稿已保留。』
findings.evidence: EN source: 'this box is paused until it is answered'. Corpus comparison keys/values: ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_gone=『未填入敏感信息字段：该请求已不再等待回复。文本已保留。』; ui.chat.asks.status.withdrawn=『已撤回——智能体不再需要回答』. Style guide i18n/style-guides/zh-CN.md §Formality & tone: Chinese drops pronouns naturally.

findings.problem: 『回复……请求』 uses 回复, which the corpus reserves for replying inside a conversation (ui.chat.reply.replying_to 『正在回复』; ui.teamBridge.replies.*), while the asks surface's own verb is 回答/答复 (ui.chat.asks.send_answer 『发送回答』; answer_aria 『你对此问题的回答：{question}』). Meaning survives; the flow's wording is not fully unified.
findings.suggestion: 『请在请求面板中答复这条敏感信息请求——……』
findings.evidence: Corpus keys/values: ui.chat.asks.send_answer=『发送回答』; ui.chat.asks.answer_aria=『你对此问题的回答：{question}』; ui.chat.reply.replying_to=『正在回复』.
